---
title: "xcdtcdy"
---

## Description

Take two SDTM character DTC dates and calculate SDTM DY variable.

## Parameters

**`dtcdate`**

: Date to calculate DY for

  *Required:* Yes

**`refdate`**

: Reference character date

  *Required:* Yes

## Examples

```sas
%xcdtcdy(exstdtc,rfstdtc);
%xcdtcdy(lbdtc,rfstdtc);
```
